bio.text: Russell Fry represents South Carolina's 7th Congressional District, which includes the Grand Strand and Pee Dee, in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He earned his undergraduate degree at the University of South Carolina and his law degree at the Charleston School of Law, and practiced law along the Grand Strand for over a decade.
Before Congress he represented State House District 106 (Horry County) in the South Carolina General Assembly for seven years, serving as Chief Majority Whip.
He lives in Murrells Inlet with his wife and son.
